en.headline: Water main bursts near Tai Tong Road Light Rail stop in Yuen Long
en.dek: Muddy water flooded part of Castle Peak Road and a pavement on Friday morning, prompting temporary lane closures while the Water Supplies Department carried out emergency repairs.
body: A water main burst near the Tai Tong Road Light Rail stop in Yuen Long on Friday morning, sending muddy water across the pavement and part of Castle Peak Road.

Police received reports at about 7.46am. The Water Supplies Department said it had closed the valves and sent staff to carry out emergency repairs. The Transport Department closed some lanes of Castle Peak Road – Yuen Long bound towards Kam Tin near Kuk Ting Street, causing congestion.

Pedestrians and vehicles had to pick their way through standing water. Some nearby food shops reported temporary disruption to their water supply. The department said it was assessing the damage and preparing a full repair plan.

zh.headline: 元朗青山公路近大棠路輕鐵站水管爆裂 部分行車線封閉
zh.dek: 今早約7時許大量黃泥水湧出行人路及馬路，水務署關掣搶修，運輸署封閉往錦田方向部分行車線。
body: 元朗青山公路近大棠路輕鐵站今早發生水管爆裂，大量黃泥水湧出行人路及部分行車線。
警方早上約7時46分接報。水務署表示已接獲報告並派員關閉水掣進行緊急維修。運輸署宣布，受事件影響，青山公路–元朗段往錦田方向近谷亭街的部分行車線已封閉，上址交通繁忙。
途人及車輛需涉水而過，附近部分食店供水一度受影響。水務署稱正制定維修方案，爭取盡早完成搶修。
